plan: -  MCU: ESP32 or Arduino Mega for sensor integration and motor control. Power: Solar panel with charge controller and battery.-  Sensors: Rain sensor, LDR/photoresistor for light, soil moisture sensor (capacitive), DHT22 for temperature/humidity.-  Actuators: DC gear motors (2 for roof retraction), water pump for irrigation, small fan for ventilation.-  Mechanical: Aluminum or PVC frame for greenhouse structure, linear rails and timing belts for roof mechanism, small nozzles for irrigation.-  Enclosures: Waterproof enclosures for electronics, 3D-printed mounts for sensors and motors.

subSteps.title: 3D print all custom mounts, enclosures, and brackets
Prepare the flexible tent cover for attachment to the roller tube
Cut irrigation tubing to desired lengths and attach drip emitters
Pre-assemble mechanical frame reinforcement brackets
Connect solar panel, battery, and 12V loads to the charge controller
Wire 5V buck converter output to ESP32 power
Connect I2C devices (Light Sensor, Battery Monitor, Display) to ESP32 SDA/SCL
Connect digital sensors (Rain, Limit Switches) to ESP32 GPIOs
Connect analog sensors (Soil Moisture, Temp/Humidity, Wind) and ultrasonic sensor (Water Level) to ESP32 pins
Wire ESP32 data pins to the Cover Motor Driver and connect to Cover Roll-up Motor
Wire ESP32 data pins to Pump and Fan Control Relays, then connect to Water Pump and Ventilation Fan
Install ESP32 development environment and all required libraries for new sensors and modules
Upload initial test firmware to ESP32, verify Wi-Fi connectivity
Test each sensor (Rain, Light, Soil, Temp/Humidity, Wind, Water Level, Limit Switches) individually for correct readings
Verify Cover Roll-up Motor operation (open/close) and limit switch functionality
Test Water Irrigation Pump and Ventilation Fan activation through relays
Verify Battery Monitor readings and Status Display output
Calibrate all relevant sensor thresholds and develop initial smart logic for prioritized control
Assemble the Greenhouse Frame Structure and install reinforcement brackets
Mount the Cover Roller Tube, Cover Roll-up Motor, and associated limit switches to the frame using 3D printed brackets
Attach the Flexible Tent Cover to the roller tube and secure its base to the frame
Mount all sensors (Rain, Light, Temp/Humidity, Wind) and the Status Display to the greenhouse frame using their 3D printed mounts/enclosures
Install the Rainwater Reservoir, mount the Water Irrigation Pump and Water Level Sensor inside, and route irrigation tubing
Mount the Ventilation Fan to the greenhouse frame using its 3D printed mount
Mount all electronics (ESP32, power management, relays, motor driver, battery monitor) inside the Main Electronics Enclosure and secure to the frame
Mount the Solar Power Panel to the greenhouse frame and connect to the Battery Charge Controller

projectDescription: An advanced autonomous greenhouse optimizes plant growth using various environmental sensors (rain, light, soil, temp/humidity, wind, water level) and a battery monitor, with data displayed locally. A main controller manages a solar-powered retractable tent cover, irrigation pump, and ventilation fan, incorporating limit switches for safety and Wi-Fi for remote monitoring and alerts.

assumptions: Basic understanding of electronics and wiring diagrams
Access to a computer with Arduino IDE or PlatformIO installed
Basic programming knowledge for uploading firmware
